purpose: Repair the unmatched functional-fixture resource evidence before bounded runtime qualification; no scientific or efficacy evidence
sourceAuthentication: Resolve each context/settings/plan/cost file through the externally pinned fixture manifest and implementation handoff; retain all consumed inputs
sameBetweenFixtures: complete physical actor and reference context
saved synthetic roots and all panel values
owner, audit, publication and evidence-retention paths

literalRules.validationChallenger: Victory on the first five ordered validation values for odd-numbered roots and first four for even-numbered roots; Draw otherwise

allocation.entropy: Reuse the already declared synthetic fixture words; no production entropy or scientific reservation

verification: Prove identical physical contexts and literal evaluator rules before either fixture runs
Prove the shared v5 proposal, pruning, panel and selected-output trajectories agree after normalizing only versioned evidence bindings
Retain all twelve complete placement catalogues for the candidate study
Keep both native and independent audits and post-publication verification active
Record actual request counts, deduplication and every native/audit time/storage partition

costRule.phaseSources: Native phase from completion; audit/publication phase uses final closeout costs, with completion costs retained and never reduced
costRule.normalization: No per-actor, per-slot or post-observation normalization; report counts and use the declared raw phase ratios
costRule.placementCostFloor: For each phase, take the maximum of the retained original placement measurement and the new paired measurement; never select the faster measurement
costRule.ratios: For each phase use max(1, placement phase floor / first matched-baseline attempt phase cost); that attempt must complete
costRule.forecast: Apply the frozen design's completed-pilot scaling, margin two, inherited admission floors, storage-before-audit scaling and 120-second publication reserve
costRule.failedEvidence: Keep incomplete and failed attempts; no silent replacement or timing resample
costRule.envelope: Use existing owned v2 limits for separately declared synthetic engineering fixtures. This plan does not start or enlarge the separate 900-second/1-GiB runtime qualification or the scientific envelope.

notPermitted: retrospective changes to the cost formula, margins or resource limits
publishing a scientific admission from synthetic fixture results alone
